traits: Cap 4 to 15 cm, brown to chestnut, very slimy and glossy, the skin peels off
Fine yellow pores, turning olive with age
Stem 4 to 12 cm, pale, with a wide ring: white above, violet-brown below
safetyNote: Edible: the DGfM and the VAPKO list it. Wikipedia (fr) calls it mediocre, the tastiest of its genus, and advises picking only young ones, peeling the cap and removing the stem; the slimy skin is laxative and may cause indigestion, and allergies are possible. It strongly accumulates caesium-137 (Wikipedia, fr). The granulated bolete has no ring; the larch bolete grows under larches; a young Gomphidius looks alike from above but has gills (Wikipedia, en).

sources.title: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Mykologie (DGfM), Fachausschuss Pilzverwertung und Toxikologie (2026). Positivliste der Speisepilze, Stand 1. Mai 2026.
